verdict.rationale: LiveKit's TurnDetector is a dedicated audio+semantic model (not just VAD silence) that predicts whether a user has finished speaking or has more to say, waiting accordingly, and adaptive interruption handling further distinguishes real barge-ins from backchanneling — directly addressing not talking over slow speakers. This is documented in detail across multiple first-party doc pages plus GitHub feature lists.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmark or community validation of the turn-detector's real-world latency/accuracy impact.
